mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_stock(tenant_id,store_id,sku_id,available,held,sold,version) VALUES(#{tenant},#{input.storeId},#{input.skuId},#{input.quantity},0,0,0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE available=available+#{input.quantity},version=version+1
mapper.select: SELECT store_id,sku_id,available,held,sold,version FROM inventory_stock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND sku_id=#{sku}
SELECT store_id,sku_id,available,held,sold,version FROM inventory_stock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND sku_id > #{after} ORDER BY sku_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_stock SET available=available-#{quantity},held=held+#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND available>=#{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT store_id,sku_id,quantity,status FROM inventory_hold WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} ORDER BY sku_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_hold SET status=#{status} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND status='RESERVED'

UPDATE inventory_stock SET held=held-#{hold.quantity},sold=sold+#{hold.quantity},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{hold.storeId} AND sku_id=#{hold.skuId} AND held>=#{hold.quantity}

UPDATE inventory_stock SET held=held-#{hold.quantity},available=available+#{hold.quantity},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{hold.storeId} AND sku_id=#{hold.skuId} AND held>=#{hold.quantity}
